message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a “Reverse” changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either:
• the color of the top discard card, **or**
• the number/symbol of the top discard card.
• A “Wild” card can be played on any card. | | **Special Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise the turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two cards as a penalty. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in each opponent’s hand:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points.
Winner gets those points added to their score. | | **Game End** | Play continues until a player reaches the target score (commonly 500). | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – you can anticipate what cards opponents might need. 2. **Use “Wild Draw Four” strategically** – it’s powerful but risky if you’re caught. 3. **Plan for “Reverse”** – in a 2‑player game it acts like a “Skip”. 4. **Remember “UNO”** – it’s a simple rule that can cost you if you forget. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
